title: Geiger Battery Bias Watch
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=geiger:cpm
| stats avg(cpm) as avg_cpm, latest(battery_v) as battery_v by sensor
| where battery_v<3.3
| sort battery_v
description: Uses Geiger sensor health telemetry to monitor low-battery conditions that may bias counts or uptime in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for detectors that need fresh power before the data degrades, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Geiger sensor health data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Sensor table of battery voltage and average CPM.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers low-battery conditions that may bias counts or uptime so you can spot detectors that need fresh power before the data degrades before it becomes annoying.
